depiction.primary_object: open hand with five fingers upright
modifiers: curved motion line at top right
curved motion line at bottom left
depiction.composition: single object, front view with motion arcs

ambiguity: At small sizes the motion arcs may fade, making it look like a plain stop/palm hand or raise-hand icon.
task_intents: send a farewell message to colleague
check in with an old friend

Go over to 4B and introduce ourselves to the new tenants
Record a two-minute welcome video for the fall cohort orientation page
Sign the group goodbye card for Elena before her last day
Draft the welcome letter for guests staying at the lake house
Post a short introduction in the neighborhood watch Discord channel tonight
Stop by the front desk on Monday morning to welcome the new receptionist in person
Write a friendly welcome note to leave on the counter for our weekend Airbnb guests
Set up a fifteen-minute coffee chat to say goodbye to David before he moves abroad

reasoning: An open palm flanked by two curved motion arcs universally reads as a waving hand for hello, welcome, or goodbye. It fits social and workplace tasks around greeting newcomers, onboarding, introductions, and farewells, though at tiny sizes it can blur into a plain raised hand.
